Maya: Quick sync on Lighthouse case study: need signed hero quote, legal OK on numbers, and a webinar slot. Target publish Mon 7/18.
Jon: I can own asset pack and short promo video. Do we have a tentative hero line from their CTO?
Avery: CTO suggested: 'Redwood halved inference spend and cut tail latency by 60%.' He can sign but legal asks we reference their internal benchmark.
Priya: Prefer 'reduced inference spend by 50% and cut tail latency by 60% (as measured in Lighthouse Q2 internal benchmark)'. Legal?
LegalBot: Automated check: numeric claims require written customer consent + benchmark reference. Also need trademark usage approval. Send to lighthouse-legal.
Maya: I'll request written consent now and ask for trademark blurb. Also schedule webinar Thurs 7/28 10am PT tentative.
Jon: Uploaded draft assets to /shared/marketing/lighthouse. Waiting on the signed email to lock hero quote.
Avery: Lighthouse legal replied: they approved the phrasing and attached signed email. Pasted into doc.
Priya: Great. I'll build webinar landing page and set nurture flow. Maya, please confirm publish embargo window length.
marketing-bot: Notice: Press embargo requires signed consent + 48h pre-announce for partner customers. See policy link.
Maya: Noted. With signed email we can schedule publish for Mon 7/18 9am PT. Jon, finalize assets and I'll request final legal stamp.
Jon: Done. Final transcript and 30s clip uploaded: s3://redwood/marketing/lighthouse/clip30.mp4
Priya: Landing live draft: https://redwood.hubspot.com/lighthouse-case. Pushed copy edits: lead with outcome, add pull quote on hero, single CTA.
Maya: All good 1 I'll lock hero quote and request legal stamp.
LegalBot: Final status: approved and stamped. Publication scheduled pending 48h pre-announce.
marketing-bot: Publication scheduled: 1749889200 -> Mon 7/18 09:00 PT (scheduled).
Avery: Confirmed speaker lineup for webinar: Lighthouse CTO, Priya (Product), and Maya (moderator).
